parameters.name: CommonName
parameters.description: The Common Name of the certificate.

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: The country or region in which the organization is located. Default value: CN.

parameters.name: Organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization. Default value: Alibaba Inc.

parameters.name: OrganizationUnit
parameters.description: The name of the department. Default value: Aliyun CDN.

parameters.name: SANs
parameters.description: The Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension that allows multiple domain names to be associated with the certificate. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: The provincial district. Default value: Zhejiang.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn create-dcdn-certificate-signing-request --common-name example.com --sa-ns example.com,example.org --organization Alibaba_Inc --organization-unit Aliyun_CDN --country CN --state Zhejiang --city Hangzhou --email username@example.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest --region cn-hangzhou --Organization Alibaba_Inc --Email 'username@example.com' --SANs 'example.com,example.org' --OrganizationUnit Aliyun_CDN --State Zhejiang --Country CN --City Hangzhou --CommonName 'example.com'
